question: In a certain test there are $n$ questions. At least $i$ questions were wrongly answered by $2^{n-i}$ students, where $i=1,2,\ldots,n$. If the total number of wrong answers given by all students is $2047$, then $n$ is equal to
solution:
The number of students giving exactly $i$ wrong answers is $2^{n-i}-2^{n-i-1}$. Therefore the total number of wrong answers is
\[
\sum_{i=1}^{n}i\left(2^{n-i}-2^{n-i-1}\right)=2^n-1.
\]
Thus $2^n-1=2047$, so $n=11$.
